items.title: Byron Stripling interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 25, 1998 [interview 1 of 2]

ctx.x: Then a group of people playing.

Yeah, a group playing together. I mean I think they can play the song but I don’t want to hear but Lester play on the solo, I don’t want to hear his solo recreated. But that’s my personal opinion. I think it’s good for people to practice that stuff, and I practiced Louis Armstrong solos, I practiced Roy Eldridge solos, Kenny Dorham. I’ve got 25 I’ve transcribed and I try to play through almost like etudes. I work on all that stuff, but I don’t really want to record it because that’s what they did. And the…

hope that some other bands come along, you know Maria Schneider has a great band, and that’s the kind, that’s a great example. And Carnegie Hall and Lincoln Center do too. There’s something to be said for that struggle you have to go through as an artist. You know I’ve been with guys in Europe and terrible players sometimes and they’ll go, “Well you know the government pays me, I got a grant to do a tour with my jazz band” and this and that, “and they gave me $100,000 for the year.” And I’m just like man but you…

items.title: Byron Stripling interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 25, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: You saw Roy Eldridge play a bunch of times.

ctx.x: Well I had to do almost the exact same scenario and some of the students seem to work well in the format and others didn’t and I wondered just how do you motivate them?

Right. So good question. What I was saying is, where I was going with that is I felt also I began each lesson with five, ten minutes max if I could, just, how are you feeling? How is this affecting you? Because that’s going to affect how you play, your desire to practice and everything. Some kids were isolated. They hadn’t left — they were scared to leave their room — some kids I had to say maybe you don’t need to go out as often. You know? So everybody was dealing with a mental thing. So I thought it was good to…

each particular — what got each particular student energized and motivated. And so a quick aside to that is for young people I’ve been finding, maybe you found this, that if the person is living then they’re more apt to be attracted to it. I don’t know if you’ve gotten that. So check it out. So I’ll tell somebody hey, bring — I want to have them do what they want to do first. I say, “Bring in a transcribed solo, anybody you want to, let’s work on it next week. Write it out a little bit if you can, if you can…
